purpose: Foundation experiments: latent scorer evaluation + basic evolution
notes: Discovered latent scorer has ~0 correlation. Hyperbolic maintains diversity but no quality signal.
Model too small (1.7B). Both geometries fail at depth 5+. Need >= 4B.

purpose: Hyperbolic vs Euclidean with verifiable arithmetic on Qwen3-4B
notes: Prompt 1 +25% hyp, Prompt 2 +25% euc. Exactly opposite = high variance. Single-prompt results unreliable.
Consistent +8% hyp advantage. Depth 3 strongest (+33.3%). No individual seed p<0.05.
c=0.5 dominates at depth 3 (+70% vs Euclidean). Lower curvature better for moderate depth.

purpose: Validate c=0.5 finding on 1.7B vs 4B models
notes: Model capacity matters. 1.7B: Euc wins. 4B: Hyp wins. Codex: 'plausible early signal, not breakthrough'.

purpose: Rigorous 5-seed run with proper statistical controls
notes: No signal. p=0.18. Evolution fitness=0.000 everywhere. Latent scorer completely blind.
INVALIDATED by Codex review. 10 issues found (4 critical). Loose verifier + magnitude normalization inflated results.
All 10 issues fixed. Codex grade: A-. Same RNG seed all conditions, matched ball radii, per-seed McNemar, etc.
Key verdict: Evidence that conditioning bandwidth matters, not that hyperbolic geometry improves reasoning. RNG-seed is the bottleneck. Soft prompt works because high-bandwidth.

purpose: Geometry isolation: hyp vs euc under identical soft prompt conditioning
notes: Evolution HURTS (90% -> 60%). Goodhart's Law: dense_score != task quality. Geometry doesn't matter when fitness is broken.

purpose: Cross-model conditioning comparison: pure vs soft prompt vs RNG seed on 4 Qwen3 sizes
notes: Both conditioning methods eliminate phantom hallucination. Non-monotonic scaling: RNG wins at 0.6B/8B, soft prompt wins at 4B/14B. Pure model always worst.

purpose: Test if different random soft prompt latents produce different accuracy
notes: WEAKLY EXPLOITABLE. Baseline 100%, 4/5 latents fail on 1 hard task (6-step chain, answer=9338). Failure mode: chain management disruption. Direction matters (Latent 1 preserves accuracy). Need harder tasks for positive signal.

purpose: Test landscape exploitability with nested expression tasks (no scaffolding)
notes: Cochran Q=23.2 (p=0.006): latents differ significantly from each other. 32% range. Best latent 96% vs 92% baseline. But 0/10 latents individually significant vs baseline (binomial p>0.05 all). Signal is inter-latent variance, not consistent improvement over baseline.

purpose: Test landscape exploitability on harder sweet-spot tasks (~60% target baseline)
notes: All 10 latents beat baseline (32%). 3/10 individually significant (binomial p<0.05): L6=56% (p=0.011), L3=52% (p=0.030), L8=52% (p=0.030). BUT Cochran Q=8.3 (p=0.504) NOT significant - latents don't differ from EACH OTHER enough. Mean improvement +12.4%. Thinking mode required (5.7h runtime).

purpose: Test landscape exploitability WITHOUT thinking mode (no-think)
notes: CRITICAL FINDING: No-think landscape is FLAT (4% range vs 32% with thinking). Chain-of-thought IS the steering mechanism. Soft prompts only influence output through reasoning chains. No-think useful for speed but NOT for finding improvements. CUDA error after L10 (VRAM accumulation).

purpose: Random-noise control: does latent direction matter or is improvement from any soft prompt tokens?
notes: WARM-START CONFIRMED. Random noise (44.0%) matches latent-projected (44.4%), Mann-Whitney p=1.0. Latent direction carries no signal. Improvement (+12pp) comes from presence of 8 extra embedding tokens at correct RMS, not from what they contain. Entire latent-to-W pipeline is irrelevant. Core thesis falsified.

purpose: V15b: Geometry isolation with accuracy-based fitness (fixes Goodhart from V15a)
notes: Evolution still hurts (-4%) even with accuracy fitness. Geometry doesn't matter (68% = 68%). Local mutation can't exploit 32% global range. Next: global search (random sampling, CMA-ES, QD with large noise).

purpose: Replicate noise control on easy tasks to confirm direction-agnostic warm-start across difficulty levels
notes: 4/5 noise vectors completed. Noise=latent (p=1.0) on easy tasks. Cross-validates sweet-spot result. Core thesis falsification confirmed across both difficulty regimes.
